title: Aging signals in rollups - ready-rot limbo age expired reservations
description: WHY: the most valuable portfolio column is oldest untouched obligation per project, and every input already exists in project event logs and record timestamps - nothing aggregates them. WHAT: extend the rollup producer (sprint G4) with aging metrics: per ready item the age since it entered ready (derivable from work.readiness_recomputed events or meta.updatedAt), per limbo item the age in its limbo state, expired reservation count and oldest, and the workspace-level maxima. Include per-item ids for the top few oldest so the global next ranker can name specific subjects. Keep computation bounded - derive from the already-loaded snapshot and event tail, no full event-log scans per mutation; document the approximation if event history is truncated. Bump the rollup schema version additively.
acceptanceCriteria: Rollup carries ready-rot, limbo-age, and expired-reservation metrics with top-item ids, covered by fixture tests with backdated records
Rollup production time stays bounded on a workspace with hundreds of items, demonstrated in a test
